name: std::forward_list<T,Allocator>::push_front
intro:
Prepends the given element value to the beginning of the container.

No iterators or references are invalidated.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
value

 -

 the value of the element to prepend

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If an exception is thrown for any reason, these functions have no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

examples.output:
std::forward_list letters holds: "def" "abc"
Moved-from string s holds: ""

summary: Prepends the given element value to the beginning of the container.
